rubric.name: ReBot quality and semantic mistake rubric
rubric.quality_scope: one integer 1-5 constant over each unchanged source-native primitive interval
rubric.mistake_scope: one row per discrete visible failure event; downstream boolean is true only within event spans

review_provenance.decision: All 61 reviewed pilot intervals are direct, successful executions under the ReBot definition and contain no discrete visible failure event. Quality distribution was not quota-forced.
